captions.detailed: This 3D model is a protective, rectangular sleeve designed to hold a flat cell phone battery. It features a slim, hollow rectangular profile with one open end for inserting the battery. The top opening has its front and back edges cut down with circular chamfers, leaving raised side tabs that facilitate easy finger grip and smooth insertion.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric cell phone battery holder case using OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the internal cavity's height, width, and depth, as well as customize the wall thickness, single-wall print width, and clearance tolerance. The top open edge must have rounded cutout corners to make sliding the battery in easier.
captions.factory: The script uses a difference() operation to create the hollow case. It starts with a solid outer cube sized according to the battery width, depth, height, wall thickness, and clearance. A second, smaller cube is translated and subtracted to form the inner cavity. Finally, two cylinders are rotated 90 degrees and translated to the top corners of the case to cut away the sharp outer corners, creating a smooth, radiused entry guide.
